properties.description: The pull for the graph: after git pull, bring this machine's live store and the working tree back into one coherent state, orchestrating what already exists. Layer 1 syncs the record — find the base (the newest export in git history both lines share), snapshot the live store (--export-snapshot works while the long-running session's server holds the lock), then fast-forward (import_graph upsert-layering, built for layering a design onto itself) when the store never moved, or the file-pure three-way (--merge to see conflicts, decide, --merge-apply) when both moved, then import the merged document and re-export straight onto the committed file so the lineage chain links. Layer 2 reconciles the code — commits in the pull that never updated the graph: reconcile_artifacts and coverage_report over the paths git names since the base, each finding walked to a two-sided answer (set_artifact_checksum / link_artifact / retire), a mini adopt pass where intent must be recovered. REVIEW MODE (req:pr-is-a-delta): the same layer-2 reading pointed at a candidate change instead of a landed one — checkout or worktree of the PR, drifted-artifact set, propagate to the capabilities/interfaces/requirements they realize, touched published or consumed interfaces named explicitly — and strictly read-only: no accepts, no writes, a report; the write half runs only when the change lands. Precedent: the 'Live-store catch-up' ChangeEvents of 2026-07-23 did layer 1 by hand; this packages that discipline. reflow2 performs no file I/O — git evidence is swept and supplied by the agent. CHANGELOG, both directions (Anthony, 2026-07-28, via keepachangelog.com): as INPUT, layer 2's intent recovery harvests the project's own changelog for the pulled range first — a changelog is the delta a human already curated, better evidence of intent than any diff — and as OUTPUT, the delta report is changelog-shaped (the KaC buckets via cap:changelog-view), so what the reconcile found reads like a document industry already knows how to read.
properties.name: Delta reconcile: present what changed since the graph last matched
